The '''''Intimidator''''' was an [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]]<ref name="USWNE" /> in service of the [[Galactic Empire]]. Under the command of [[Admiral]] [[Gorin]], it participated in the [[Battle of Scarif]] in [[1 BBY]], where it was rammed by the [[Star Destroyer]] ''[[Persecutor]]'', which in turn had been pushed by the [[Sphyrna-class Hammerhead corvette|''Sphyrna''-class Hammerhead corvette]] ''[[Lightmaker]]''. The combined wreckage of all three [[Starship|ships]] then fell into the [[Scarif]] [[Shield Gate]], destroying it.<ref name="Rogue One" />

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|The colliding Star Destroyers are the Intimidator and the Persecutor, or as we came to affectionately know them in production, Timmy & Percy.|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|<ref name="Pablo">{{Twitter|pabl0hidalgo|status/1741240349878841593|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|quote=The colliding Star Destroyers are the Intimidator and the Persecutor, or as we came to affectionately know them in production, Timmy  & Percy.|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/IiTy5}}</ref>}}
The ''Intimidator'' first appeared in the [[2016]] film ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''.<ref name="Rogue One" /> It was identified by name in "Sacred Ground," an article written by Joe Fordham and published in the [[February]] [[2017]] magazine [[Wikipedia:Cinefex|''Cinefex'']] 151,<ref name="Cinefex">{{BookCite|author=Fordham, Joe|container=Sacred Ground|title=[[Wikipedia:Cinefex|Cinefex]]|number=no. 151|date=February 2017}}</ref> though [[John Knoll]] had previously confirmed on [[Wikipedia:Reddit|Reddit]] that the ships involved in the crash are "the ''Persecutor'' and the ''Intimidator''. Affectionately known to the crew at ILM as Timmy and Percy."<ref name="Reddit">{{Reddit|url=r/StarWars/comments/5k6cq4/anybody_know_the_names_of_two_particular_star/dbme8sm|thread=Anybody know the names of two particular Star Destroyers that appear in Rogue One?|user=[[John Knoll|JohnKnoll]]|date=2016-12-25|quote=The two ships are the Persecutor and the Intimidator. Affectionately known to the crew at ILM as Timmy and Percy.|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/NWSzu}}</ref> The [[November 15]], 2017<ref name="Hachette">{{Hachette|fr=1|url=livre/geektionnaire-star-wars-9782011461261|text=Geektionnaire Star Wars|language=French|quote=Paru le: 15 Novembre 2017}}</ref> reference book ''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]'' officially confirmed the names that had been provided in the ''Cinefex'' article.<ref name="Geektionary">''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]''</ref>
